Mina / Elena — confirmed from the platform side:

- Export schema: our Trust Portal session export (CSV) contains the following columns: session_id, user_email, session_start_utc, session_end_utc, ip_address (x-forwarded-for), user_agent, action_type, resource_path, file_download_count, bytes_transferred. I attached a small sample spec.
- Retention: portal stores audit-grade events for 180 days by default; exports are generated on-demand.
- Credential expiry: the one-time SSO link TTL is configurable up to 168 hours (7 days). For temporary credentials (provisioned reviewer accounts) we currently support max 120 hours. Given your ask we can provide either: 1) one-time SSO link with 168-hour TTL, or 2) reviewer credentials with a 120-hour TTL.
- IP capture: x-forwarded-for is recorded when present; if auditor is behind NAT/proxy they may see a proxy IP — we surface both remote_addr and x_forwarded_for when available.

I’ve attached session-export-spec.csv (sample columns + brief notes). If you need additional fields we can add session_hash and request_id, but that will take a small config change.

-Karthik
Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
